title: Junior System QA Engineer- ETR- Israel
description: Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.        Who We Are      The Silicon One team creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development-from design to qualification to production-is within our team, we're able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world.            What You'll Do      Understand customer use cases and turn them into clear, repeatable automated test scenarios.  Use the existing test environment to develop, run, and maintain system-level tests.  Design scenarios that examine how features interact and how those interactions affect overall system behavior.  Learn how SDK behavior and ASIC architecture come together in real networking systems.  Analyze test results, investigate failures, and help identify root causes across software and hardware.  Work with engineers across the organization to improve test coverage and product quality.  Contribute targeted enhancements to the automation framework when they help make tests more reliable, reusable, or efficient.    Minimum Qualifications     B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering from a leading Israeli university with GPA of 80+.   Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.  Foundation in object-oriented design and ability to write clear, maintainable code.  Familiarity with parallel programming or concurrent execution.  Ability to investigate problems methodically, analyze results, and refine code.  Ability to reason about how features interact and how their combined behavior affects a system.    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with Python and common software design patterns.  Understanding of networking concepts and protocols.  Experience with automated testing, test-case design, or system validation.  Openness to feedback and ability to apply it while working independently.     Why Cisco?   At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.  Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.   We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
